name: Coreweaver Labs
description: Portable public context for humans, crawlers, coding agents, and automation harnesses.

interoperability.supportedClients: Any browser, crawler, model, IDE, coding agent, or harness that can read standard Git, HTTP, HTML, JSON, Markdown, or plain text.

publicSurfaces.purpose: Human-readable homepage and JSON-LD entity graph.
AI systems architecture and trust silo.

content.sourceOfTruth: Git repository for public copy and structure; optional providers may supply blog records at build time.
content.fallbackBehavior: The static site remains buildable when optional external providers are unavailable.
content.claimPolicy: Public claims should be source-backed, dated where material, and reviewable in Git.
content.antiSlopPolicy: Every new page must add original analysis, a useful canonical definition, or a proprietary framework; generic summaries are rejected.
content.measurementPolicy: Measure fixed probe-query sets, technical crawlability, citation accuracy, and source coverage; do not treat any single score as a guarantee.

contributing.workflow: Use a feature branch, run npm ci and npm run build, inspect generated dist/, then open a pull request.
contributing.secrets: Never commit .env files, tokens, private records, or credentials.
contributing.compatibility: Do not require a proprietary assistant, agent runtime, plugin, or hosted control plane to build or revise the site.
